applies_why: The judge text addresses whether the challenger's cited verses against Matthew 1:20 count and says the point was answered in CR3 LINK 2.
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: Because the judge explicitly marks the point as answered in [CR3] LINK 2, K-G4 says an answered verse is not counted, so no unanswered-witness counting occurs.
